mapper.sql: m.lot_id, m.lot_no, m.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, m.wo_id, m.occurred_at
mapper.select: select from lot_master m join mst_item i on i.item_id = m.item_id where m.lot_id in #{id} order by m.lot_id

select m.lot_id, m.origin, m.supplier_cust_id, c.cust_cd as supplier_cd, c.cust_nm as supplier_nm, m.supplier_lot_no from lot_master m left join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = m.supplier_cust_id where m.lot_id in #{id} order by m.lot_id
select from lot_master m join mst_item i on i.item_id = m.item_id where m.lot_no = #{lotNo}
